name: apify-b2b-super-tools-mcp
displayName: Apify B2B Super-Tools MCP Server Suite
description: 7 High-performance automated B2B tools for Claude, Cursor, and AI Agents covering E-Commerce migrations, domain security auditing, 404 repair, public tenders, and MCP model registries.
author: Deepak Sheoran

tools.name: store_catalog_redirect_extractor
tools.description: Extracts complete product catalogues and generates 100% SEO-safe 301 redirect CSV mappings for Shopify, WooCommerce, and BigCommerce replatforming.

tools.name: domain_security_super_auditor
tools.displayName: Bulk Domain Security, SSL/TLS, Headers & DMARC Auditor
tools.description: High-speed multi-domain infrastructure scanner benchmarking TLS 1.3, SSL certificate expiry, HSTS, CSP, and SPF/DKIM/DMARC email security compliance in seconds.

tools.name: catalog_feed_normalizer
tools.description: Ingests dirty multi-vendor CSV/JSON supplier feeds and transforms unescaped quotes, delimiters, variant matrices, and ISO-4217 currencies into clean Shopify RFC 4180 feeds.

tools.name: website_health_checker
tools.displayName: Bulk Website Health, 404 Broken Link & SEO Technical Auditor
tools.description: High-throughput crawler auditing 404 errors, redirect loops, TTFB latency bottlenecks, missing meta tags, and broken anchor links across thousands of pages.

tools.name: indian_public_tender_parser
tools.displayName: India Public Tender, GeM & CPPP eProcurement Scraper
tools.description: Automated ingestion engine extracting Indian public procurement notices, GeM bids, CPPP tables, standardized EMD amounts, and UTC submission deadlines.

tools.name: openrouter_mcp_registry
tools.displayName: OpenRouter LLM Pricing & AI MCP Server Registry Scraper
tools.description: Continuous sync pipeline tracking 200+ frontier AI models, prompt/completion token pricing, context window lengths, and validated Model Context Protocol server tools.

tools.name: domain_protocol_signals_enricher
tools.displayName: Domain Well-Known Protocol & App Link Signals Enricher
tools.description: Technographic enrichment tool probing RFC 9116 security.txt, Apple App Site Association (AASA), Android assetlinks.json, and OAuth well-known discovery endpoints.
